system.description:
You no longer summon the darkness within — you become it, collapsing into a pseudo-liquid humanoid outline of utter blackness that pours through cracks and sees through any ordinary night.

Spend three Blood Traits and three full turns of concentration doing nothing else. In this form you cannot be harmed by physical attacks, though magic, fire and sunlight still injure you, and you cannot physically affect your surroundings. By enveloping a victim — your Mental Traits challenging his Physical Traits — you inflict the disorientation, darkness and smothering of Shroud of Night. You ignore gravity and can slither along any surface, and may use mental Disciplines within the form's limits (having no eyes, you cannot use Dominate, but can hide with Obfuscate). Your Blood Traits become inky darkness immune to Thaumaturgy. Fire and sunlight are excruciating, imposing a one-Trait penalty on your Courage Tests.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
